:::{#exm-RD}

#### Difference in MI risk

Recall the shorthand $\pi(OC)$ and $\pi(\neg OC)$ from @exr-probs
for the probability of MI given OC use and given OC non-use,
respectively.

In @exm-oc-mi, the [maximum likelihood estimate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-mle) of the difference in MI [risk](#def-risk-epi) between OC users and OC non-users is:
```{r, include = FALSE}
#| label: compute-risk-diff
rd_OC <- p_MI_OC - p_MI_nOC # nolint: object_name_linter
```

$$
\begin{aligned}
\hat\delta(\pi(OC), \pi(\neg OC))
&= \delta(\hat\pi(OC), \hat\pi(\neg OC))\\
&= \hat\pi(OC) - \hat\pi(\neg OC)\\
&= `r p_MI_OC` - `r p_MI_nOC`\\
&= `r rd_OC`
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
